new_destinations.name: Vavaʻu
new_destinations.coordinates_source: centre of the kept spots (Neiafu to Hunga Island to ʻEneʻio); final centre to confirm at the pin stage
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage has a page 'Vava'u' (https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Vava'u) and Tonga Tourism lists it as 'Our Islands: Vava'u' (https://www.tongatourism.travel/our-islands/vavau); it is Tonga's whale-watching and sailing region, one of its five tourist regions.
new_destinations.reason: Seven kept places cluster round Neiafu, the region visitors name; the region (not the town Neiafu) is the destination and Neiafu is its first spot.

spots.name: Neiafu
spots.bio: Vavaʻu's main town on a sheltered harbour, the base for yachts, whale-watching and island day tours.
spots.reason: Kept by skeptic; reached by boat or road from Neiafu, inside the Vavaʻu group.

spots.name: Mariners Cave
spots.bio: A sea cave on Nuapapu island entered by an underwater tunnel, visited on boat tours from Neiafu.
spots.reason: Kept by skeptic; reached by boat or road from Neiafu, inside the Vavaʻu group.

spots.name: Swallows Cave
spots.bio: A sea cave on Kapa island that boat tours stop at for swimming and snorkelling in clear blue water.
spots.reason: Kept by skeptic; reached by boat or road from Neiafu, inside the Vavaʻu group.

spots.name: Hunga Island
spots.bio: An island 35 minutes by boat from Neiafu whose sheltered bays are where humpback whales rest with their calves in season.
spots.reason: Kept by skeptic; reached by boat or road from Neiafu, inside the Vavaʻu group.

spots.name: 'Ene'io Botanical Garden
spots.bio: Tonga's only botanical garden, on Vavaʻu's east coast, with a visitors' centre and tapa and kava demonstrations.

standalone_within_40km: None: no standalone spots in this region; all seven kept places are within 15 km of the Vavaʻu centre.

review_not_placed.name: Utakalongalu Market
review_not_placed.reason: Neiafu market with fruit and fish on Wikivoyage Buy list; days not stated, so cannot confirm daily trade (rule 4). Case for: town market is a cultural stop. Against: one source, may be weekly/daily-morning only.
review_not_placed.objection: Only one source; could be a plain produce market.

review_not_placed.name: Utula'aina Point Lookout
review_not_placed.reason: Wikivoyage names the walk past Holonga to the lookout and down to Secret Beach; one source, half-day walk. Case for: a coastal walk with views. Against: minimal info, part of one walk with Secret Beach.
review_not_placed.objection: Single source, no verified track, near-duplicate with Secret Beach.

review_not_placed.name: Toafa Church
review_not_placed.reason: Wikivoyage names it as a viewing point over Hunga cliffs; church judged for view only. Case for: guide singles out the view. Against: local church, one source, view only.
review_not_placed.objection: Looks like a parish church on a point.

review_not_placed.name: Vava'u Pearl Centre
review_not_placed.reason: Two Tonga Tourism pages name it as the place to learn about mabe pearls; Case for: displays and a visitor draw. Against: basically a shop, 0 views.
review_not_placed.objection: Likely a retail shop with a display.

review_not_placed.name: Ava Pulepulekai
review_not_placed.reason: Tonga Tourism highlight: 11 km fjord-like channel; visited by boat. Case for: official highlight, distinct scenery. Against: one source, a waterway rather than a stop, no coordinates.
review_not_placed.objection: Feature or area, not a point to visit.

notes: Tonga has no existing destinations or spots. Mt Talau National Park has fewer than four spots so is a spot, not a destination. Pin stage: Hunga Island, Pangaimotu and Mt Talau coordinates are centroids or listing geo and need visitor points.
